dialogue.text: Spring Equinox Day and Night are equal.
dialogue.zh: 春分日白天和黑夜一樣長。
dialogue.ja: 春分の日は昼と夜の長さが同じです。
dialogue.local: Spring Equinox Day and Night are equal.
dialogue.en: Spring Equinox Day and Night are equal.

dialogue.text: Around March 21st is the Spring Equinox.
dialogue.zh: 春分大約在三月二十一日左右。
dialogue.ja: 春分はだいたい3月21日頃です。
dialogue.local: Around March 21st is the Spring Equinox.
dialogue.en: Around March 21st is the Spring Equinox.

dialogue.text: On this special day, Daytime and Nighttime are exactly equal.
dialogue.zh: 在這特別的日子裡，白天和黑夜完全相等。
dialogue.ja: この特別な日には、昼と夜の長さが正確に同じです。
dialogue.local: On this special day, Daytime and Nighttime are exactly equal.
dialogue.en: On this special day, Daytime and Nighttime are exactly equal.

dialogue.text: 12 hours of light, 12 hours of dark.
dialogue.ja: 昼が12時間、夜も12時間です。
dialogue.local: 12 hours of light, 12 hours of dark.
dialogue.en: 12 hours of light, 12 hours of dark.

dialogue.text: After today, days will keep getting longer.
dialogue.zh: 從今天起，白天會越來越長。
dialogue.ja: 今日を過ぎると、日がどんどん長くなります。
dialogue.local: After today, days will keep getting longer.
dialogue.en: After today, days will keep getting longer.

dialogue.ja: 春はちょうど半分が過ぎたところです。

dialogue.zh: 萬物開始綠意盎然，茁壯成長。
dialogue.ja: すべてが緑に覆われ、成長しています。

dialogue.text: There's a fun tradition balancing eggs on their ends.
dialogue.zh: 有個有趣的傳統是把蛋立起來平衡。
dialogue.ja: 卵を立ててバランスをとる楽しい伝統があります。
dialogue.local: There's a fun tradition balancing eggs on their ends.
dialogue.en: There's a fun tradition balancing eggs on their ends.

dialogue.text: People say it's easiest to balance an egg on the Spring Equinox.
dialogue.zh: 人們說春分日最容易把蛋立起來。
dialogue.ja: 春分の日に卵を立てるのが一番簡単だと言われています。
dialogue.local: People say it's easiest to balance an egg on the Spring Equinox.
dialogue.en: People say it's easiest to balance an egg on the Spring Equinox.
